overall.includes: page text Width 45'-6" and Depth 46'-0". The plans print room sizes only; the rear porch label 45'-6" x 10'-0" runs the full house width, and on the plan pixels (14.05 px/ft from that width) the depth from the garage front wall to the face of the rear bay is 46.1 ft. So width = side wall to side wall, depth = garage front wall to rear bay face; the 10 ft rear porch/decks and the spiral stair are outside these numbers

levels.note: no height is printed anywhere (no section, no level marks, no page height). uncertain: Imperial source: printed literals are Width 45'-6" and Depth 46'-0" (page text), porch 22'-9" x 4'-6", rear porch 45'-6" x 10'-0". No overall dimension is printed on the plans themselves, so every sideLengthM is DERIVED: front and rear 45'-6" = 13.868 m (the rear-porch label spans the full width), left 46'-0" = 14.021 m (garage front to rear bay face, 46.1 ft on plan pixels), right 46'-0" minus the 4'-6" porch set-back = 41'-6" = 12.65 m (plan pixels give 41.4 ft).

No ridge or building height is published, so the ridge sanity check cannot be made; ridgeRowPx is the tower roof peak. The front and left sheets are drawn at about 48.8 px/m, the rear and right sheets at about 50 px/m; this is consistent with the wall ends chosen (rear walls at the heavy corner lines 238/934 rather than the lighter lines 246/922).

Zero row: no level mark. Front/left use the porch-deck / brick-base row 690, rear/right the French-door sill row 700; each may be off by about 10 px (0.2 m). Ground-level window heads then come out 2.15-2.30 m and sills 0.66-0.76 m above the floor.

Window + French doors + window groups (F8, B7, B11, B12) and the double pairs of French doors in the bay (B4, B9) are given as ONE opening each because the units stand in one trimmed surround with posts of only 0.1-0.2 m between them; they could be split into three (or two) openings.
F5, F7, F8, B7, B9, B11, B12, L9 are partly hidden by railings, B1/B2/R5 by the spiral stair: boxes are the full frames as far as they can be followed.
F11 (small gable window) touches the head trim of F10 and may be its transom.
Bay side windows (L1, R5, R9, B3, B5, B8, B10) are in canted walls and are drawn foreshortened; each physical canted window therefore appears on two elevations (rear and one side).
The integral 2-car garage is part of the main block (no separate garage body); garage openings carry body MAIN.
No chimney is drawn on any elevation although the 2nd- and 3rd-level plans show fireplaces; chimneys = 0 follows the elevations.
The tower shows windows on the front, left and rear faces; its right face shows shingles only (partly hidden by the wing roof), so no opening is listed there.
